selection_rationale: Covers the seven frozen measurement-tools sub_types with the hand-held and software references a French live/broadcast technician meets: NTi Audio XL2/XL3 and Minirator (very common in French rental stock, with French manuals and LNE-approved XL3), Rion NL-53 for class 1 environmental metering, Smaart and REW for system tuning, Audio Precision APx555 B as the lab analyzer reference, RTW TouchMonitor and NUGEN VisLM for EBU R 128 loudness, plus inexpensive cable and polarity testers used for stock maintenance. NL-52 was swapped for its current successor family member NL-53 because the Rion site no longer lists NL-52; HBK 2250, TC Electronic Clarity M, Cirrus Optimus and NTi Minilyzer ML1 were dropped because no primary page could be read (see not_found_log).
